title: Lesson 23: IP Action Types: Groups, Data Mapper, HTTP, Remote, Sub-IP
description: Configure Groups, Data Mapper Actions (Extract, Load, Transform), Standard Actions (Remote Actions, HTTP Actions, Response Actions, Sub-Integration Procedures), etc.

questions.question: Which action returns data from an IP to its caller?
questions.explanation: The Response Action defines what the IP returns.

questions.question: An IP must call a REST API using a Named Credential. Which action?
questions.explanation: HTTP Actions make REST callouts; Named Credentials carry auth.

questions.question: Which action invokes another Integration Procedure?
questions.explanation: Sub-IP actions compose IPs for modular orchestration.
